title: Zegna Group's operating profit rises to 74.5 million in H1
summary: Ermenegildo Zegna reported revenues of 987.3 million euros (1.15 billion dollars) in the first half, up 6 percent year-over-year and 9 percent on an organic basis. The direct-to-consumer channel drove the performance with a growth of 12 percent (+16 percent on an organic basis), accounting for 86 percent of the group's brand revenues. Meanwhile, the ongoing rationalisation of the wholesale channel across the three brands resulted in a 14.6 percent decline in wholesale revenues (-13.3 percent on an organic basis).

title: Neelam Shami Rao: “We must develop products better suited to the European market”
summary: Automated translation With the Free Trade Agreement (FTA), India has gained a significant tariff advantage to strengthen its presence in the European textile market. How does the country plan to transform its industry and offering to capitalise on this? FashionUnited spoke exclusively with Neelam Shami Rao, secretary of the Indian Ministry of Textiles, during her visit to the Texworld trade fair.

title: Marilyne Trebus, Kering's new product asset
summary: Automated translation Luxury group Kering is continuing to strengthen its centres of excellence with the appointment of Marilyne Trebus as its new product director, effective immediately this Tuesday, according to a report by WWD. In her new role, she will report to Carlo Mocci, chief client officer, who took up his position last May and joined the group's executive committee.

title: Moncler launches citywide Retrospective in New York
summary: Moncler is set to launch a new retrospective across the city of New York, culminating at Vanderbilt Hall at the Grand Central Terminal, in honor of its 15-plus-year cultural bond with the city as it opens its largest flagship store to date. Named ‘New York in Moncler,’ the retrospective runs from September 9th through to the 13th, coinciding with New York Fashion Week. The open-air exhibition includes large-scale photographs installed in communal spaces that trace the history of the luxury brand and the city, focusing on the people, the locations and the shows that formed Moncler’s New York identity.

title: Very Group sale scrapped as bidders decline two billion pound asking price
summary: The potential sale of British online retailer Very Group is reportedly close to being scrapped after prospective buyers declined to meet the two billion pound asking price.

title: Retail: how a store gets customers to travel for it
summary: Automated translation Brick and mortar retail has been under pressure for years. E-commerce gained ground on the very factors where the high street struggles to compete: convenience and reach. Consequently, shops in many city centres that relied on passing trade have quietly disappeared. However, a category of stores seems to be bucking this trend. These businesses do not compete on convenience but on something else entirely, offering a reason to visit that goes beyond mere necessity.

title: Lands' End reports Q2 revenue growth and return to profitability
summary: US clothing retailer Lands’ End Inc. increased its revenue and returned to profitability in the second quarter of the 2026/27 financial year, according to an interim report published on Thursday.

title: Victoria's Secret raises forecasts after strong second quarter growth
summary: US lingerie retailer Victoria’s Secret & Co. achieved significant growth in sales and earnings in the second quarter of the 2026/27 financial year. In light of this recent positive development, management raised its full-year forecast on Thursday.

title: NYC compliance notice puts new scrutiny on Victoria’s Secret over Sri Lankan supplier worker death
summary: Victoria’s Secret is facing scrutiny once more in regard to its supply-chain practices after New York City’s Commission on Human Rights issued a compliance notice concerning a local casting call for its upcoming “Angels Among Us” campaign.

title: Innovative Eyewear achieves over 1 million dollars in quarterly revenue
summary: US-based smart eyewear developer Innovative Eyewear Incorporated has announced significant business progress for the third quarter of 2026. The Miami-headquartered developer and manufacturer, known for brands such as Lucyd, Lucyd Armor, Reebok, Nautica and Eddie Bauer, recorded record commercial performance alongside a series of retail expansions and strategic technology alliances.

title: Acne Studios marks 30th anniversary with new campaign by Nan Goldin
summary: Acne Studios is marking its 30th anniversary with the launch of a new campaign that showcases the foundational material that it all started with: denim. Shot by American photographer Nan Goldin, marking the first collaboration between the two, the campaign showcases friends of the brand wearing current, archived, and re-edition denim styles across Acne Studios three decade history.

title: American Eagle launches first collaboration with Lamine Yamal
summary: American Eagle is releasing its first product collaboration with Lamine Yamal on Thursday, six weeks after the Barcelona winger lifted the World Cup with Spain. The collection leans on the loose, streetwear-adjacent style Yamal favours away from the pitch, including baggy denim, cargo trousers, hooded denim jackets, oversized denim shirting and basics. Yamal, who described himself as still "finding my own style" in comments accompanying the launch, is being positioned by the retailer as a conduit to Gen Z consumers.
